description.value: Vista 18 is a full-service restaurant and lounge on the 18th floor of the Chateau Victoria hotel in downtown Victoria, offering sweeping panoramic views of the Inner Harbour, Juan de Fuca Strait, and the Olympic Mountains. The menu features fresh, seasonal Pacific Northwest cuisine led by Chef de Cuisine Brett Yamashiro, whose background includes time at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Switzerland and Fairmont Jasper Park Lodge. Touring cyclists arriving in Victoria's downtown core will find a distinctly elevated dining experience anchored by an extensive B.C. and Vancouver Island wine program.
